reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' and the cited Section 14.8 text contains only supervision/assignment/subcontracting language — no 'shall not solicit', 'employ or engage', 'no-hire' or 'induce ... to leave' trigger, so the preferred position (no non-solicit on Customer) is satisfied.
No redline or counterparty comment is proposed, which is the correct output for a compliant presence-rule finding; the unchanged paragraphs match the originals exactly.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) presuppose an existing non-solicit clause and are therefore inapplicable here; they are not evidence of a defect.

Rationale correctly distinguishes Section 14.16 (freedom to contract with others) from a restrictive covenant and records the fallback position should a non-solicit later appear in an SOW, which is useful internal evidence without raising an unnecessary negotiation issue.
